title: A Current for the Summit
author: C. M. Crane
blurb: Ada Okonkwo, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
